picks.name: Byrne Chelsea Boot, dark brown leather
picks.why: Answers the 'less clunky than Docs' office boot: slim Chelsea profile, storm welt and a Vibram sole that grips on wet Bangor pavements. Dark brown leather shrugs off rain better than suede. Wear with the pleated trousers or stone chinos, hem just kissing the boot. £120 vs £280 RRP.

picks.name: Chore Jacket, putty
picks.why: The chore/field jacket is a cornerstone of the brief and this one is UK-made, logo-free cotton canvas. Putty sits in the stone/taupe family, so it pairs tonally with navy and olive. The olive version was rejected at £140 in July; at £42 this is the best value on the board.

picks.name: Relaxed Chinos, navy
picks.why: Only chino on the list that is genuinely in stock in W34 L32 and under target today. Navy is the workhorse colour: office with the Chelsea boots, weekends with the Era or Wallabees.
